_about: Draft (lane A5, 11 Nov 2026): Amora's words for the one-flow steward page and the resident path. Not applied by anything. The content lane may refine them; apply each through Admin, Pages or PUT /api/admin/content/<key>.

hero.headline: Build {village} with us
hero.intro: Roles are how the work of {village} gets done. Everyone starts on the same first steps: the webinar or community call, a land tour and the potluck. Then the path divides: hold a role, live here, or both.

getToKnow.heading: Get to know us
getToKnow.body: Optional to visit, required to apply. Take them in this order, and tick each one off as you go.
getToKnow.exceptions: We encourage you to do these, but if you haven't, you can still apply, especially if you've been invited to, or if you're not in Costa Rica and the next webinar is more than a week away, or if you feel you're an incredibly strong candidate. For a role we urgently need, you may start after the webinar alone.

items.title: Attend the webinar or community call
items.description: Live is best, or watch the recording. Meet the founding team, hear the vision and ask your questions.

items.title: Come on a land tour
items.description: Weekly, right after the potluck. If that day doesn't work for you, we can arrange a special tour.
items.bullet3: Ask us for a special tour

items.title: Join the potluck
items.description: Take part in an event: share a meal with the village and meet us as we live.
items.bullet2: Meet the people who live here

tracks.heading: Two paths from here
tracks.body: After the first steps the path divides. Walk one, or both.
tracks.stewardLine: Hold a role on the founding team that takes {village} from idea to flourishing village.
tracks.residentLine: Make {village} your home, from Guest and Founding Seeder to Steward of {village}.

steps.heading: The steward path
steps.intro: From your application to your seat on the team, in {count} steps. Each says whose move it is.

items.title: Find your role
items.description: Read the open lead roles. Each card says what the role holds, the background we'd love to see, and that it is a paid role.

items.title: Apply for the role
items.description: Apply from the role's card, in six steps: get to know us, about you, your value, the terms, your first day, and review.

items.title: Our review
items.description: We read every application. We invite some applicants to interview, and send everyone else a warm thank-you.

items.title: Interviews
items.description: Three conversations: Operations (60 minutes) first, then CRM & Hiring (30), then the Visionary (30).

items.title: The decision, by consent
items.description: The circle decides together. People choose people, and we tell you what we decided.

items.title: Your first cycle
items.description: One paid month, from the end of November to the end of December. Either side may end it there.

items.title: Seated in the role
items.description: Your first conversations include Technical Operations, and you take up the role with the team.

crossover.title: Join the resident path too
crossover.body: We prefer to work with people who also want to live here at least part time.

foundingTeam.heading: The team that builds {village}
foundingTeam.body: We are building the team that will lead each domain of {village}, from the foundation through to completion. The roles open now are {foundingRoles}. A rare invitation, for people ready to hold a whole domain.

extras.heading: Optional, any time
extras.body: None of these is needed to apply. Each is a deeper way to know us.

items.title: Other events
items.description: Workshops, gatherings and celebrations on the land.

items.title: Village immersion
items.description: Spend unhurried time in the village, see circles at work and find where your gifts fit.

items.title: Community training
items.description: Our training in NVC (Nonviolent Communication), authentic relating and other community practices, once you have joined.

rights.heading: Your rights and responsibilities
rights.body: Read what we ask of you, what you can count on from us, and how leaving a role works.

dues.heading: Village Dues
dues.fallback: As a resident, you'll pay Village Dues that cover utilities, maintenance, and community services. Together, we work to reduce costs and create surplus that benefits everyone.

hero.intro: The Resident Space is for those coordinating the success of the whole Village from the perspective of Residents. Find your place in a loving community where all beings belong and thrive.
hero.headline: Make {village} Home

steps.heading: The resident path
steps.intro: From Guest to Steward of {village}, and the invitation to make your home here. Each stage helps both sides decide.

items.title: Visit as a Guest
items.description: Open to everyone, with no commitment. Come back to events, workshops and celebrations as often as you like.

items.title: Become a Founding Seeder
items.bullet2: First access to homes and land
items.description: A $100 gift, with no deposit. Founding Seeders are our waitlist of soul-aligned people with first access to homes and land at {village}. This is how you say: I'm serious about this.

items.title: Reserve your lot
items.description: After an in-person conversation with a core team member, reserve your lot with a refundable deposit{range}.

items.title: The opening ceremony
items.description: Held on the land at the opening of each season. The community witnesses your commitment, and you are named a Steward of {village}.
items.bullet1: At the opening of the season

items.title: Live as a Steward
items.description: Full community participation: visit the land, come to events, and complete our training in NVC and authentic relating.

items.title: Sit with the Wisdom Council
items.description: Before the season closes, you sit with the Wisdom Council of {village}.

items.title: The closing ceremony
items.description: At the close of each season, with elders and the full community as witness, certified Stewards are invited to purchase their home or lot.
items.bullet1: At the close of the season

items.title: Accept the invitation to purchase
items.description: Agree the terms of your home or lot with {village} and sign.

items.title: Build Your Home
items.description: Work with our approved builders or bring your own plans. Observe Resident Governance.

items.title: Move In Celebration!
items.description: Welcome home! Celebrate with the {village} Family and begin your life in the village.

rights.body: As a resident you are a co-owner of this village, not a tenant. Read the full covenant that protects you and defines what we're building together.
rights.heading: Your Rights and Responsibilities

tenure.body: Your Land Share Agreement gives you long-term access to your land with the ability to renew and pass down to your children{transfer-note}. The structure holds ownership in the community and gives your family security.
tenure.heading: Land Share Agreements

titles.body: {village} marks long presence with a title. These titles are honorary: they carry no voice in governance and no rights today. Voice comes from what you contribute, and a village may decide later to attach powers of its own to these titles.

items.description: Your arrival, you've made the village your home
Deep roots, steward of community traditions
Village wisdom keeper, mentor to new residents
Intergenerational bridge, keeper of the village's longest memory

titles.heading: Titles for Time Here

closing.body: Start with a community call to learn about life at {village}, then explore our housing options and available lots.
closing.heading: Find Your Home

nextStep.body: Schedule a village visit to experience {village} firsthand and ask any questions about becoming a resident.
nextStep.heading: Your Next Step

entry.heading: Start with the first steps
entry.body: Everyone begins here, whichever path you walk. Tick each one off as you go.
